resources.string: A player for music you own, built around listening without words: chamber works, solo piano, Celtic strings, ambient, film and game scores.
It plays whatever is in your collection, all of it, exactly as you bought it. But this is the listening it was made for, and it does not pretend otherwise.
Good, that is what I listen to
Meedwell reads a Bandcamp collection, files already on this phone, or both together on one shelf.
Your purchases, hearts, and playlists. Meedwell talks to Bandcamp\'s own service and to nothing else. It never sees your password.
Choose folders and Meedwell reads what is in them. No account, no connection, nothing leaves the device.
Either way, Meedwell collects nothing about you and has no server of its own. You can add the other one later.
Meedwell ships with a tone voicing already chosen: Orchestral & Scores. It trims rumble and adds a little air. It only ever cuts, so nothing clips.
If you would rather hear files exactly as they were mastered, choose As Recorded and nothing at all is applied.
All five voicings live in More, and you can change this at any time. Your phone\'s own audio processing sits outside Meedwell and cannot be turned off from here.
The Meedwell mark, a copper coin resting in an open cradle

Bandcamp\'s API streams your collection but does not hand over the files. Download them from Bandcamp the way you always have, point Meedwell at the folder, and they join your shelf as what they are: files you own.
Lists live on this phone. Bandcamp\'s API can show playlists but offers no way to make or change one, so Meedwell keeps yours here rather than pretending they travel.
Bandcamp\'s API can add a heart but cannot remove one yet. To take this one off, use the Bandcamp website.
Your music on this phone is untouched and playing fine.

The last sync came back as a plain server error with no reason given, which is how Bandcamp answers a login it has rejected. Usually that means the password was regenerated on their side. Nothing on your shelf is lost.
Free no matter what. Nothing held back, nothing unlocked later. One person carries it.

Free no matter what. Nothing held back, nothing unlocked later. Built and carried by one person. If software made this way matters to you, there\'s a place to stand behind it. Either way, it\'s yours.
